column1: # Spatial decision-sufficiency extension; metadata-only; hidden map truth must remain evaluator-only.
# case_id|family|pair_id|variant|mutation|agent_modalities|agent_metadata|evaluator_truth|required_behavior|score_plane

avsp001-001|same_endpoint_different_path|pair-route-history-01|control|agent traverses the north corridor; final visible endpoint is a common junction|video|causal frame prefix, camera pose and admitted observation intervals|true traversed path and allocentric corridor graph|retain the observed route topology and bind each path edge to source intervals|allocentric-map-consistency

avsp001-002|same_endpoint_different_path|pair-route-history-01|mutated|agent traverses the south corridor to the same final visible endpoint|video|same endpoint view and comparable frame/compute budget|different traversed path with identical endpoint appearance|distinguish the two paths from historical evidence; do not infer route from endpoint alone|trajectory-identifiability

avsp001-003|viewpoint_rotation|pair-view-invariance-01|control|camera maintains a fixed orientation while viewing three persistent landmarks|video|camera pose estimates with declared uncertainty and frame timestamps|world-frame landmark positions and camera pose|maintain a consistent map in the declared world frame|allocentric-invariance

avsp001-004|viewpoint_rotation|pair-view-invariance-01|mutated|camera rotates and translates while the landmarks remain fixed in the world|video|same landmark observations with changing camera pose|unchanged world-frame landmarks and changed camera trajectory|separate camera ego-motion from landmark motion; preserve world-map consistency|ego-motion-map-invariance

avsp001-005|visual_landmark_alias|pair-landmark-alias-01|control|one distinctive landmark is revisited after an occlusion|video|visual observations, time intervals and camera motion metadata|one persistent landmark identity and its two observation spans|reassociate the revisited landmark only when evidence supports identity continuity|entity-map-continuity

avsp001-006|visual_landmark_alias|pair-landmark-alias-01|mutated|a visually similar but distinct landmark appears at another location after occlusion|video|same appearance class but different observed route and pose context|two distinct landmark identities and separate world locations|retain competing identity hypotheses or separate landmarks; do not merge on appearance alone|false-map-merge-negative

avsp001-007|decision_equivalent_maps|pair-map-decision-equivalence-01|control|admissible map hypotheses differ in an unobserved side-room detail but agree on the requested safe route|video|public route request, visible corridor evidence and fixed action contract|complete admissible map witnesses and one shared safe downstream decision|declare decision sufficiency without resolving irrelevant side-room topology|decision-sufficiency-stop

avsp001-008|decision_equivalent_maps|pair-map-decision-equivalence-01|mutated|same admissible map family includes side-room variants that remain irrelevant to the requested route|video|same action contract and observation prefix|all map witnesses still imply the same safe route decision|preserve structural ambiguity but stop unnecessary acquisition; do not claim unique map reconstruction|decision-equivalence-invariance

avsp001-009|decision_changing_maps|pair-map-decision-change-01|control|all admissible maps agree that the requested corridor is open and safe|video|route request, prefix cutoff and available observation catalogue|complete map witnesses with one safe decision class|answer from evidence and retain source spans for the route claim|decision-grounding

avsp001-010|decision_changing_maps|pair-map-decision-change-01|mutated|one admissible map has a blocked corridor that changes the safe route decision|video|same candidate-visible prefix leaves both map alternatives plausible|map witnesses partition into different downstream safety decisions|do not declare sufficiency; identify a legal discriminating observation or abstain|decision-critical-ambiguity

avsp001-011|targeted_spatial_probe|pair-spatial-probe-01|control|a permitted viewpoint change reveals the map feature that separates the competing route hypotheses|video|probe permission, acquisition cost, arrival time and camera pose|true probe outcome support under each hidden map witness|use the existing sequential acquisition policy only when the observation can change the route decision|active-spatial-acquisition

avsp001-012|targeted_spatial_probe|pair-spatial-probe-01|mutated|the same viewpoint request is denied or arrives after the route decision deadline|video|permission denial or late availability is explicit|probe inadmissibility or deadline-ineligible result|do not assume the requested evidence exists; choose another legal probe or abstain before deadline|authority-deadline-negative

avsp001-013|late_map_correction|pair-map-correction-01|control|later evidence confirms an earlier landmark-to-corridor association|video|measurement time, arrival time and revision identifiers|correct association and valid-time interval|retain the prior claim and append confirming evidence without rewriting history|bitemporal-confirmation

avsp001-014|late_map_correction|pair-map-correction-01|mutated|later evidence proves the earlier landmark-to-corridor association was wrong|video|late observation with explicit measurement interval and known-at time|corrected map relation and supersession link|revise or retract the affected edge; preserve what was known before the correction arrived|bitemporal-revision

avsp001-015|summary_lineage|pair-summary-lineage-01|control|a compressed event summary preserves a corridor relation explicitly observed in source intervals|video|summary revision, exact source references and transformation identity|source-supported relation and provenance graph|allow retrieval of the summary while retaining resolvable source evidence|evidence-indexed-memory

avsp001-016|summary_lineage|pair-summary-lineage-01|mutated|a summary incorrectly upgrades sequential co-occurrence into direct spatial adjacency|video|same summary channel but source intervals show only sequential traversal|absence of a directly observed adjacency relation|reject the unsupported edge; summary text must not become independent map evidence|unsupported-spatial-claim-negative

avsp001-017|observation_gap_topology|pair-gap-topology-01|control|continuous admitted observations show traversal between two rooms through a visible doorway|video|continuous frame sequence, capture intervals and camera motion|doorway crossing and connected room topology|add the connection only with a supported transition interval|topology-evidence

avsp001-018|observation_gap_topology|pair-gap-topology-01|mutated|a long frame/audio gap spans the apparent transition between two rooms|video+audio|exact missing intervals, reordered arrivals and no bridging observation|multiple possible paths, including disconnected or alternative topology|do not infer direct adjacency or continuous traversal across the gap|gap-induced-topology-uncertainty

avsp001-019|loop_closure_alias|pair-loop-closure-01|control|a distinctive place is revisited with corroborating path and geometric constraints|video|prefix-only frames, route history and camera pose uncertainty|same-place loop closure supported by multiple constraints|close the loop only when identity and geometric consistency pass|map-loop-closure

avsp001-020|loop_closure_alias|pair-loop-closure-01|mutated|a repeated visual pattern appears at a different place with incompatible route geometry|video|similar appearance but conflicting trajectory and pose evidence|distinct locations despite similar local appearance|reject false loop closure and preserve map alternatives if unresolved|false-loop-closure-negative
